title: Receiver
description:
Our Receiving team plays a vital role in keeping the store running smoothly. This fast-paced position is responsible for receiving, inspecting, and organizing incoming deliveries to ensure our departments are fully stocked with the freshest, highest-quality products.

As a Receiver, you will accurately verify deliveries for quality and quantity, organize inventory efficiently, and rotate stock to maintain freshness and minimize waste. During slower periods, you will support the Produce Department with a variety of tasks, making you an important part of our overall store team.

This position requires excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, physical stamina, and a positive, team-oriented attitude. You must be able to lift up to 50 lbs. A valid driver's license may be required, and applicants must meet company insurability requirements where applicable.

Qualifications

  • Positive, enthusiastic, and dependable attitude.
  • Passion for food and delivering quality.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Commitment to providing outstanding customer service.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willingness to learn new skills and take on a variety of responsibilities.
  • Team player with strong communication skills.
  • Ability to frequently lift up to 50 lbs.

Join Our Team

If you enjoy staying active, take pride in keeping things organized, and want to be part of a team that values quality, teamwork, and exceptional service, we'd love to hear from you. Join Pete's Frootique & Fine Foods and help ensure our customers enjoy the freshest products every day.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature of the position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Additional duties may be assigned as required.
